objective: Evaluate the unfitted layered Type-III tank filling model on a fresh, outcome-unseen trace after resolving the inlet geometry and boundary-temperature ambiguity.

source_context.prior_result_interpretation: The original frozen result remains negative and is not revised by this protocol.
source_context.new_trace_requirement: A fresh trace, an untouched source-held split, or a custodian-run evaluation is required. Reusing the already inspected archived outcome arrays is ineligible for confirmatory validation.

tank_internal_diameter_m.source: published Dickens experiment description and archived case

tank_internal_length_m.resolution_rule: Do not choose by model error or reported volume. Record the custodian-confirmed physical length and its evidence before opening any new outcome values.

tank_internal_volume_m3.resolution_rule: Derive from the frozen diameter and custodian-confirmed length; do not independently fit volume.

required_input_contract.time_s: monotonic elapsed time from fill start
required_input_contract.mass_flow_kg_s: measured inlet mass flow or a cumulative delivered-mass trace with documented differentiation rule
required_input_contract.mean_gas_temperature_k: measured tank mean-gas temperature or documented equivalent
required_input_contract.sampling_and_quality: sampling interval, missingness, synchronization, calibration and uncertainty flags
required_input_contract.initial_conditions: initial pressure, gas temperature and wall temperatures
required_input_contract.geometry_and_materials: frozen diameter, resolved length, inlet pipe geometry, liner/shell thickness and material properties

frozen_model.state: uniform gas plus separate aluminium-liner and composite-shell temperatures
frozen_model.inlet_enthalpy: co-located measured inlet pressure and time-resolved inlet temperature
frozen_model.inlet_jet_mixing: unfitted forced-convection term using the declared 5 mm inlet geometry and source-independent correlation
frozen_model.wall_heat_transfer: declared natural-convection and layer-conduction correlations from the existing runtime implementation
frozen_model.integration: BDF with the existing frozen tolerances and measured-time output grid

primary_screens.joint_rule: All four screens must pass for a case to count as a joint pass; a failed or incomplete case is retained.

analysis_sequence: Receive metadata and rights statement without numerical outcomes.
Resolve and record the physical tank length, volume derivation and channel crosswalk.
Hash the new trace or custodian-run package and freeze this protocol plus the selected case split.
Open numerical outcomes only after the freeze record is complete.
Run the unchanged model once per eligible case with no fitting, smoothing, time warping or case removal.
Publish aggregate metrics, residual checks and all failures; do not promote a post-outcome sensitivity to validation.
claim_boundary: A passing fresh trace supports only transfer of the layered Type-III tank-filling submodel under the resolved geometry and measured boundary conditions. It does not validate the HRS cascade, compressor, precooler, dispenser metering, consequence distances, safety logic, or SAGA effectiveness.
